Framework_Desc: Built with Next.js 15, utilizing the latest App Router, React Server Components (RSC), and Turbopack for lightning-fast performance.
Styling_Desc: Custom styles using Vanilla CSS and Tailwind CSS, focusing on a unique aesthetic with multi-theme support (Modern, Cinematic, Editorial).
Database_Desc: Serverless database management using Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL hosted on Supabase, ensuring data integrity and scalability.
Localization_Desc: Comprehensive i18n support for 18+ languages, ensuring accessibility and a seamless experience for a global audience.
Holistic_Approach_Desc: A holistic software engineering approach combining modern web standards, rigorous type safety (TypeScript), and performance-driven design.
Performance_Score_Desc: Achieving scores of 92 for Performance, and perfect 100s for Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO. Validated through DebugBear, ensuring exceptional average load times and solid core web vitals.
